decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch fits the core seasonal assortment and existing workshop skills, so it costs little to hold even though it has not been visible since 2018.
The one-tier pyramid is a typical long-lived item in traditional wooden folk art ranges, and its low holding cost justifies keeping the option despite little recent visibility.

The flagship electronic music box line is still the firm's main growth option beyond its core, but its absence from the website since 2018 suggests weak results, so it is kept under closer scrutiny rather than expanded.

Like the already withdrawn Christmas platform, this distant low-visibility accessory has shown no evidence of value after four years, so it is cut to focus resources on the core business and the main music box line.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on core competencies and has steady gift and tourist appeal at minimal holding cost, so the option remains worth holding.
